philosophy: No public alpha or beta releases. Rig Relay goes directly to public v1 when genuinely ready. Internal proving replaces public staging. Every proving stage must produce structured evidence artifacts (JSON/JSONL). No proving stage passes based on visual inspection alone.

proving_stages.name: Connected Studio Integration
proving_stages.description: Wire production backend projections to all five Gridline frontend surfaces. Remove fixture data from default path. Each surface must show real data or a truthful empty/deferred state.
gates: Connect surface shows real provider status and identity
RepositoryEstate surface shows real repo observations (or truthful empty state)
ProjectStudio surface either hidden or shows real compilation results
InferenceStudio surface either hidden or shows real probe results
PublishPreview surface either hidden or shows real previews
No fixture data in default bundle path
Model/runtime selection UX wired end-to-end

proving_stages.name: Provider Feature Parity
proving_stages.description: Close provider gaps: Gemini tool calling, Mistral registration, cost tracking, cache-hit visibility. Resolve after W1 publishes.
gates: Gemini tool calling and structured output implemented and tested
Mistral registered as first-class provider or documented as unsupported
Cost calculation from token counts × price for all providers
Cache-hit rate and savings surfaced in frontend Connect panel
Provider evidence ledger records per-invocation cost

proving_stages.name: UI Polish and Accessibility
proving_stages.description: Designer-reviewed visual polish pass. Empty/error/refusal/degraded/offline UX for all surfaces. WCAG 2.1 AA audit and remediation.
gates: Designer sign-off on typography, spacing, color, motion
Light and dark mode both polished
Delight effects finished and not excessive
Empty states designed for all five surfaces
Error/refusal states designed with recovery paths
Offline/degraded states render gracefully
WCAG 2.1 AA audit pass
VoiceOver labels correct on all interactive elements
Full keyboard-only navigation pass
Color contrast pass (minimum 4.5:1 for text)

proving_stages.name: macOS App Packaging
proving_stages.description: Build signed and notarized .app bundle. Create DMG installer. Implement Sparkle updates. Clean install/uninstall flow.
gates: .app bundle builds successfully
Double-click launch works on clean macOS
Gridline frontend loads and connects to bridge server
DMG created with drag-to-Applications
Sparkle update check succeeds against appcast
Sparkle update download and install works
Install via DMG → drag → launch → onboard → chat works end-to-end
Uninstall via Trash works (no zombie processes)
State directory documented and cleanable

proving_stages.name: Code Signing and Notarization
proving_stages.description: Sign .app bundle with Developer ID. Submit for notarization. Staple ticket. Verify Gatekeeper acceptance.
gates: codesign -dvvv shows valid Developer ID signature
Hardened runtime enabled
Entitlements file correct (network client, audio input, file access)
notarytool submission succeeds
Notarization accepted by Apple
Stapler validates ticket
spctl --assess passes without warnings
Gatekeeper shows no warning on first launch (after notarization cache)

proving_stages.name: Legal Review
proving_stages.description: Attorney review of privacy notice, usage terms, license compliance. SBOM generation.
gates: Privacy notice attorney-reviewed and published
Usage data license attorney-reviewed and published
GDPR/CCPA compliance assessment complete
Complete THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md with all dependencies
SBOM generated (CycloneDX or SPDX format)
AGPL-3.0 compliance reviewed for macOS bundled distribution
Apache 2.0 NOTICE obligations reviewed

proving_stages.name: Evidence Integrity and Recovery
proving_stages.description: Corruption injection and recovery testing across all evidence domains. Verify publication evidence exactly-once guarantees. Verify timeline reconstruction integrity.
gates: Simulated evidence corruption detected by degradation markers
Reconstruction from canonical sources succeeds for repository estate
Reconstruction from canonical sources succeeds for investigation timeline
Publication evidence exactly-once under concurrent retry (T1.2 verified)
Timeline reconstruction integrity verified (T4.2 verified)
No silent corruption scenarios survive corruption test suite

proving_stages.name: Long-Session Stability Testing
proving_stages.description: Multi-hour operational testing. Memory profiling. Connection recovery. Error accumulation under sustained load.
gates: 24-hour idle stability: no memory leaks > 50MB growth
50-message sustained chat: no degradation in response time
Connection drop: bridge server recovers without restart
WebSocket reconnect: frontend reconnects and resyncs state
Concurrent agent sessions: 4 parallel sessions complete without interference
Crash recovery: evidence state intact after force-quit and relaunch

proving_stages.name: Optional Private Preflight Cohort
proving_stages.description: Distribute signed/notarized build to a small trusted cohort (5-10 users). Collect structured feedback. Fix critical issues before public release.
gates: Cohort members can install, launch, configure provider, and complete a basic coding task
No crash-on-launch or blocker-level issues reported within first week
All cohort-reported issues are triaged (fix or defer before public release)
Cohort confirms product is useful and worth releasing

proving_stages.name: Public v1 Launch
proving_stages.description: Publish DMG on GitHub Releases. Publish Sparkle appcast. Update website. Announce.
gates: DMG published on GitHub Releases with SHA256 checksum
Sparkle appcast published and accessible
Website updated with download link and documentation
Launch announcement prepared
Support channels configured (GitHub Discussions or equivalent)
Rollback plan documented (previous DMG available)

parallelizable_stages: Stage 3 (UI/Accessibility) can overlap with Stage 2 (Provider Parity) since they affect different subsystems
Stage 4 (Packaging) can overlap with Stages 5-6 (Signing, Legal) as dependencies permit
Stage 6 (Legal) should start early — attorney review has unpredictable timeline
Stage 7 (Evidence Integrity) can run in parallel with Stage 8 (Stability) once T1.2 and T4.2 are published
critical_path: Stage 1 (Connected Studio) → Stage 3 (UI/Accessibility) → Stage 4 (Packaging) → Stage 5 (Signing) → Stage 8 (Stability) → Stage 10 (Launch). Stages 2, 6, 7, and 9 are parallelizable.
estimated_total_duration: 12-22 weeks from Stage 1 start to public launch, depending on Apple Developer enrollment, attorney availability, and W0/W1 decision timing
external_dependencies: Apple Developer Program enrollment — required for Stage 5 (no bypass for direct distribution)
W0 OMLX strategy publication — required to finalize Inference Studio scope
W1 provider caching/cost policy — required for Stage 2 cost tracking and cache visibility
T1.2 publication exactly-once closure — required for Stage 7 evidence integrity
T4.2 timeline authority closure — required for Stage 7 evidence integrity
Attorney availability for legal review — required for Stage 6
telemetry_and_privacy_in_proving: All proving stages produce content-light evidence only. No raw user prompts, model outputs, file contents, or secrets in any proving artifact. SHA256 hashes for all content-derived references. Proving build credentials (signing keys, notarization credentials) never appear in evidence artifacts.
